verdict.rationale: Docs show merchant applications have states like created/started that can be edited/pre-filled, and ISVs can track onboarding progress item-by-item via the Dashboard, suggesting some staged onboarding exists. However there is no explicit documentation of a minimum-to-sell threshold, deferred data collection tied to payout limits, or a defined 'requirements-due' state model per seller as described in the story. Missing for 10: explicit payout-threshold-triggered data requirements, documented requirements-due status labels, and evidence of configurable minimum onboarding fields.
